eyebrow.zh: 录一次 · 永久重放 · 改版自愈
eyebrow.en: Record once · Replay forever · Self-heals on change

headline.zh:
把一次浏览器走查
变成永远能重放的能力
headline.en:
Turn one browser walkthrough
into a capability you can replay forever

sub.zh: 录一次人工流程，结晶成参数化资产；站点改版时用你自己的 key 自动重定位，修好就存盘——不再每次重新推理。
sub.en: Record a human flow once into a parameterized asset; when the site changes it re-locates with your own key and saves the fix — no re-inference every run.

body.zh: 人工走一遍流程，自动结晶成可复用资产；重放零推理调用，每次确定性跑通。
body.en: Walk through a flow once; it becomes a reusable asset. Replay makes zero inference calls — deterministic every time.

body.zh: selector 漂移时，用你自己的 key 对实时 DOM 重定位；修好的定位当场存盘，哪怕后面的步骤失败也不丢。话多的模型、模糊的定位都不再让自愈静默翻车。
body.en: When a selector drifts, it re-locates against the live DOM with your own key and saves the fix on the spot — even if a later step then fails. Chatty models and ambiguous matches no longer break heal silently.

body.zh: 本地 UI 把硬编码值改成 {{param}}、删多余步、声明参数；关掉标签或 Ctrl-C 都能干净退出，参数化的 URL 在校验阶段就拦下，不再跑到一半才出错。
body.en: A local UI turns hard-coded values into {{param}}, prunes steps, declares params. Closing the tab or Ctrl-C exits cleanly, and a {{param}} in a URL is caught up front — no half-run surprises.

title.zh: CI 里校验，资产即制品

body.zh: 不启浏览器、不调 LLM 即校验 .flow.json 结构与参数，无效则非零退出——把流程资产当一等制品管理。
body.en: Validate a .flow.json's structure and params with no browser and no LLM — non-zero exit on failure, so flows are first-class artifacts you can gate in CI.

headline.en: Record once. Stop re-inferring every run.

sub.zh: 把今天的演示，变成明天还能跑的能力。
sub.en: Turn today's demo into a capability that still runs tomorrow.

tag.zh: Apache-2.0 · 本地优先 · 你的 LLM key
tag.en: Apache-2.0 · Local-first · Your own LLM key
